title: Top 5 Most IMPORTANT Space Missions Ever
yt_titles: Would We Even Be Here Without These 5 Missions?
hook: Number one is still flying 24 billion km away.

items.name: Hubble Space Telescope
items.stat: Launched 1990, still delivering images 1.5 billion light-years deep

items.name: Sputnik 1
items.stat: First satellite ever, 1957 — beeped and started the Space Age

items.name: Cassini-Huygens
items.stat: 13 years orbiting Saturn, landed a probe on Titan

items.name: Apollo 11
items.stat: 1969 — first humans to walk on the Moon

items.name: Voyager 1
items.stat: Only spacecraft in interstellar space, launched 1977
